text:
Hi,

Claire here, from Nora Lanelle. I saw your checkout is still open, so I wanted to write myself rather than send you a banner.

Nothing is reserved until you pay, and I'd rather you hear that from me than find out later. The 45% Autumn Sale is already in your total, in USD, no conversion surprises. If it's easier to pay later, Klarna and PayPal are right at the last step.

If you stopped because of the size, that's the most common reason, and the easiest to fix. Reply with your usual size and your height, and I'll tell you which to take. I read every reply myself.

And if it isn't right when it arrives, you have thirty days at home and returns are easy. That's the whole point of it.

Back to your checkout: https://nora-lanelle.com/checkout

Warmly,
Claire
Nora Lanelle

PS: Nina, 39, from Dallas, wrote last week: "paid with klarna, coat came in 9 days, heavier than i expected which is what i wanted. runs a little roomy".
